Subcategory: Out Of Range And Signal Loss
MenuPath: World > Industry Marker or Industry App
Preconditions: A site can be approached and then left before interaction or while its tablet is open.
ActionSteps: Stand just outside an industry marker and press E; then open a valid industry tablet in range and walk or drive out of range until the signal is lost.
ExpectedUIResult: Out of range, no in-range prompt appears and E does not open the tablet; after leaving range from an open tablet, Site / Signal unavailable / Industry Signal Lost appears.
ExpectedGameplayResult: No unintended load or unload action occurs while out of range.
ExpectedPersistenceResult: No out-of-range interaction state is saved.
ExpectedNotificationOrFeedback: No industry marker in range. or Industry Signal Lost state appears according to path.
ExpectedSuccessOrProgress: No success progress should change from failed or blocked interaction.
NegativeOrEdgeCondition: Out-of-range interaction must not open stale site data or perform cargo actions.
PassCriteria: Pass if industry interaction is correctly gated by range and signal-loss handling.

MenuPath: Network > Contractor Permit or Industry page
ControlOrButton: Purchase Permit; Buy Industry; Load Product; Unload Cargo
Preconditions: Licensing system is On and the targeted site still requires its permit or purchase.
ActionSteps: Attempt to haul to or from a permit-locked site without buying its permit; attempt purchase on insufficient funds; attempt industry actions on a site still requiring purchase.
ExpectedUIResult: Permit or purchase rows remain visible and blocked detail stays on screen instead of silently allowing the action.
ExpectedGameplayResult: No blocked cargo flow or ownership change completes.
ExpectedFinanceOrStateChange: No money is charged on blocked actions.
ExpectedPersistenceResult: Blocked state persists after save/load until the player actually purchases the permit or site.
ExpectedNotificationOrFeedback: Current permit or purchase blocker text remains visible and the action does not complete.
ExpectedSuccessOrProgress: No success progress should advance from blocked site access.
NegativeOrEdgeCondition: Permit or purchase-gated actions must not bypass current ownership or licensing rules.
PassCriteria: Pass if locked or unaffordable site actions fail safely without changing state.
